Items.Name: Good News About Hell
Items.Overview: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

Items.Name: Half Loop
Items.Overview: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

Items.Name: In Perpetuity
Items.Overview: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

Items.Name: The You You Are
Items.Overview: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

Items.Name: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
Items.Overview: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.
